notes.title: Update 1.09
notes.notes:
Hello!

Forgot to post this when it went live, but here are the patch notes for update 1.09!

[list]
[*] Fixed seam in track
[*] Lighting changes made to all tracks
[*] Changed hover effect
[list]
[*] Should have less of a performance hit now and is now simplified
[/list]
[*] Added a new player model to the interior of the car
[*] Fixed leaderboards not updating when changing level
[*] Fixed the incorrect count for total leaderboard entries
[*] World best times now shown on the level select
[*] Removed old main menu theme from playing
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update 1.05.2
notes.notes:
Hello!
Small (but important) bug fix today.
[list]
• Fixed controller input not working correctly
[list]
	○ Controls were inverted for the right joystick, and were very sensitive (for both joysticks)
[list]
		- This sensitivity (and invertedness) has been changed/adjusted accordingly
		- And the controls for the right joystick have been fixed. So now going forward actually pushes you forward on the right side of the car
[/list]
[/list]
[/list]

Other than that, I've been doing some quality of life changes that are likely to be released sometime shortly, so keep an eye out for that!

notes.title: Demo Update 1.05.1
notes.notes:
Hello!

Small changes to the game UI today to make the timer as well as checkpoint and lap text more visible as well as a bug fix for the tutorial UI where it was possible to have it stuck on for the duration of a race.

Other than that, Take The Wheels! has just been ported over to a newer version of the Unreal Engine, which is why the update is so massive today (sorry! I was informed of the bug just after the project had been ported). I've also been hard at work on a brand new short track that might be featured in an upcoming demo update! (a more beginner friendly track that should help people acclimatised to the unique control scheme that is featured in Take The Wheels!) So keep your eyes peeled!

It has been great to see the attention that Take The Wheels! has been getting since update 1.05 dropped start of last week!

notes.title: Demo update 1.04.1
notes.notes:
Hello!
Just a very small update for today!
- Fixed the pause menu to now actually pause the game
- Changed the main menu background to be blue instead of red

Again, very small update, but work is being done on the main game and hope to show more soon!

notes.title: Demo Update 1.02
notes.notes:
Hello! Small update for the Take The Wheels! demo today. Some minor changes made to the vehicle camera as well as control changes to the car to make it more sticky to the ground (less bouncy on landings)

- Camera now has small amount of lag behind the car when in motion (and turning)
- Changes made to the loading effect during the countdown
- Countdown decreased from 5 seconds to 3 seconds
- Changes made to car to make it more grounded and sticky.
+ It should feel less bouncy when landing from heights.

More work is currently being done on some new tracks for the Early Access release of Take The Wheels! so keep an eye out!
